policy: Every feature route remains public. Systems without verified output carry a prominent pilot or baseline-building label; no clock, receipt, recall, baseline or material change is invented.

features.title: Public Answer Clock
features.statusHeading: Pilot ledger — no verified clock is running yet.
features.statusCopy: Question records exist, but none has verified delivery evidence. Every clock remains stopped, and silence is not treated as guilt, refusal or proof.
features.activationRule: A clock becomes verified only after a delivery event has a verifiable channel, target, timestamp and receipt or equivalent proof.

features.title: Lived Consequence Receipts
features.statusHeading: Private intake is open — no receipt has cleared public review.
features.statusCopy: No public receipt is being claimed. Submissions remain private unless lawfully obtained, redacted, explicitly approved for publication and reviewed by a named human.
features.activationRule: A receipt becomes verified public output only after redaction, lawful-source review, explicit publish consent and named human approval.

features.title: Evidence Half-Life
features.statusHeading: Monitoring ledger — no evidence recall notice is active.
features.statusCopy: Review dates exist, but no record has crossed the threshold for an active recall notice. Evidence age is not evidence of falsity.
features.activationRule: A recall becomes verified output only when an attributable record has a visible reason, review requirement and correction route.

features.title: Power Diff
features.statusHeading: Baseline-building stage — no historical material change is claimed.
features.statusCopy: Current fingerprints have been established, but there is no genuine earlier snapshot for a defensible historical comparison. A baseline is not a change.
features.activationRule: A change becomes verified output only after a genuine earlier snapshot exists and a source-linked difference survives materiality and evidence-boundary review.
